name: Sillina

attributes.attribute: gave her name to the Isles of Scilly
site of a large Roman-era shrine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sillina is a British goddess. Her existence is not proven. Scholars believe a goddess of this name once gave her name to the Isles of Scilly. A large Roman-era shrine was found there. The shrine offers a clue to the old faith. The goddess may have been honored on the western isles before the Romans came. The isles keep her memory in their name. No inscription names her. The link rests on the name of the isles alone. Still, the shrine marks a holy place that the Romans built over an earlier one.
